name: hp_wand
stats_provenance: Ours: spells are the Halo plasma pistol's bolts, a little harder hitting and tighter. First-person wand and spell sound from the Workshop's '[Harry Potter] Magic Wand (70 spells!)' (410020480); in other hands the wand is HL2's stun baton (no world wand ships).
material_overrides_provenance: The wand SWEP's Lua points its view model's 'wand' material at the addon's own texture; the model's $cdmaterials say v_physcannon.
